CPV.note: State data centre described as serving state platforms; no statement that it rents to outside organisations, no Tier or cloud region.

facts.fact: Cabo Verde's Secretary of State for the Digital Economy said the State Data Center in Praia, run under NOSi, sustains the state's digital platforms and services to citizens and businesses.

CPV.note: Document is about solar power at the state data centre; nothing on fibre.
NOSi promoted the ceremony, but the document does not state that its staff run or build government systems.
State-owned data centre named, but no statement that it is for hire, nor its Tier.
The technology park in Praia is mentioned only as the ceremony site; no tenants or programmes stated.
